sentence: This project develops methods that need less infrastructure to check how well skin tumor surgery has worked.
This project tests peptides and small molecules from a DNA-encoded library to build an oral drug that acts on the insulin receptor.
This project studies the role of RNA editing in organizing the cytoplasm of cells.
This project combines gene expression data from perturbation experiments with computer methods to build networks that link genes to complex traits and disease.
This project studies how early onset colorectal cancer changes differently by sex and tests deleting asparagine synthetase in models of the cancer.
This project provides laboratory assays and a biomarker specimen repository to support HIV research.
This project provides genetic counseling and cancer genetics expertise to support research on inherited cancer.
This project builds software that uses artificial intelligence to find active kinase networks and study poorly understood kinases.
This project tries to find out which genes in regions linked to coronary artery disease are involved and how they contribute to the disease.
This project studies how parent and child interactions relate to emotion regulation in preschoolers with autism spectrum disorder.
This project sets up a fluorescence microscope that takes high-resolution images of live and fixed cells, organoids, and tissue sections.
This project studies how blocking an oncoprotein changes the way cells respond in pancreatic cancer.
This project tests a fluorescence imaging technology that helps surgeons remove tumors during head and neck cancer surgery.
This project links advances in genomics, proteomics and artificial intelligence with biomedical imaging and image-guided therapies.
This project uses continuous glucose monitoring and machine learning to find glucose patterns that show who is at high risk of developing diabetes.
This project studies how disrupted granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor signaling leads to lipid problems and surfactant buildup in the lung disease pulmonary alveolar proteinosis.
This project expands the simulation software used to run computer simulations in biomechanics and biophysics.
This project builds treatments for botulism poisoning that use nanobodies to block the toxin inside motor neurons.
This project builds tools to find and measure chemical changes to RNA molecules in tissues, single cells and other settings.
This project tests whether mini-proteins designed by artificial intelligence can help stem cells turn into islet tissue.
